propositions: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map use unpaginated search_issues calls that silently truncate results to the first 50 issues by relying on the default max_results parameter
issues beyond the first 50 in a project appear to have no links and no comments in the sync output, causing spurious mutations and loss of removals
search_issues terminates on requested page size rather than on empty pages, which causes silent data loss when Jira DC caps pages below the requested maxResults
a shared _paged_search helper must be extracted and routed through all three transport methods to eliminate hand-rolled truncation-prone loops
the pager must advance by len(batch) and terminate only on empty pages to handle Jira DC's silent truncation behavior
